actions.ask_genie.description: Asks a Genie space a question in plain language and returns the answer and query results.
actions.ask_genie.props.conversationId.d: Optional. The Conversation ID from an earlier Ask Genie step, to ask a follow-up question in the same conversation.
actions.ask_genie.props.genieSpaceId.des: The Genie space to ask. The service principal needs "Can run" permission on it.
actions.ask_genie.props.question.descrip: The question to ask, e.g. "What were the top 5 products by revenue last month?"
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.find_rows.description: Finds rows in a Unity Catalog table where a column matches a value.
actions.find_rows.props.columnName.descr: Only return rows whose value in this column equals Filter Value. Leave empty to return the first rows of the table.
actions.find_rows.props.filterValue.desc: The value to match in the filter column, e.g. 1042 or jane@example.com.
actions.find_rows.props.limit.descriptio: Maximum number of rows to return (1-10000). Defaults to 100.
actions.find_rows.props.schemaName.descr: The schema inside the selected catalog.
actions.find_rows.props.tableName.descri: The table inside the selected schema.
actions.find_rows.props.warehouseId.desc: The SQL warehouse that runs the statement. The service principal needs "Can use" permission on it.
actions.insert_row.description: Adds one row to a Unity Catalog table.
actions.insert_row.props.rowFields.descr: One field per table column. Leave a field empty to skip that column.
actions.insert_row.props.schemaName.desc: The schema inside the selected catalog.
actions.insert_row.props.tableName.descr: The table inside the selected schema.
actions.insert_row.props.warehouseId.des: The SQL warehouse that runs the statement. The service principal needs "Can use" permission on it.
actions.insert_rows.description: Adds many rows to a Unity Catalog table in one statement.
actions.insert_rows.props.schemaName.des: The schema inside the selected catalog.
actions.insert_rows.props.tableName.desc: The table inside the selected schema.
actions.insert_rows.props.warehouseId.de: The SQL warehouse that runs the statement. The service principal needs "Can use" permission on it.
actions.run_query.description: Runs any SQL statement on a SQL warehouse and returns the result rows.
actions.run_query.props.parameters.descr: Values for the :name markers in the query, e.g. status → shipped. Values are passed as strings; cast in SQL when needed, e.g. CAST(:amount AS DECIMAL(10,2)).
actions.run_query.props.query.descriptio: The SQL statement to run. Use fully qualified table names and :name markers for values, e.g. SELECT * FROM main.sales.orders WHERE status = :status LIMIT 100
actions.run_query.props.warehouseId.desc: The SQL warehouse that runs the statement. The service principal needs "Can use" permission on it.
actions.update_rows.description: Updates the rows of a Unity Catalog table where a column matches a value.
actions.update_rows.props.columnName.des: Rows whose value in this column equals Match Value are updated.
actions.update_rows.props.matchValue.des: The value to look for in the match column, e.g. 1042 or jane@example.com.
actions.update_rows.props.rowFields.desc: Fill in only the columns to change. Empty fields are left as they are.
actions.update_rows.props.schemaName.des: The schema inside the selected catalog.
actions.update_rows.props.tableName.desc: The table inside the selected schema.
actions.update_rows.props.warehouseId.de: The SQL warehouse that runs the statement. The service principal needs "Can use" permission on it.
actions.upload_file_to_volume.descriptio: Uploads a file to a Unity Catalog volume and, optionally, loads it into a table with COPY INTO.
actions.upload_file_to_volume.props.file: The file to upload, e.g. a CSV or JSON file from an FTP, email or HTTP step.
How the file is read when it is loaded into the table.
JSON (an array of objects, or one object over several lines)
actions.upload_file_to_volume.props.fold: Optional folder inside the volume, e.g. imports/orders. It is created if it does not exist.
actions.upload_file_to_volume.props.sche: The schema inside the selected catalog.
actions.upload_file_to_volume.props.shou: When the file has columns the table does not, add them to the table instead of failing.
actions.upload_file_to_volume.props.tabl: Optional. A table in the same catalog and schema to load the file into with COPY INTO. Leave empty to only upload the file.
actions.upload_file_to_volume.props.volu: The Unity Catalog volume the file is uploaded to, inside the selected schema.
actions.upload_file_to_volume.props.ware: The SQL warehouse that runs COPY INTO. Required when Load into Table is set.
actions.upsert_row.description: Updates the row with a matching key, or inserts it if no row matches (MERGE).
actions.upsert_row.props.columnName.desc: The column that identifies a row, e.g. id or email. A row with the same value is updated; otherwise a new row is inserted.
actions.upsert_row.props.rowFields.descr: One field per table column. The key column must be filled in. Empty fields are not changed on update and inserted as NULL.
actions.upsert_row.props.schemaName.desc: The schema inside the selected catalog.
actions.upsert_row.props.tableName.descr: The table inside the selected schema.
actions.upsert_row.props.warehouseId.des: The SQL warehouse that runs the statement. The service principal needs "Can use" permission on it.
auth.description:
Connect with a Databricks service principal (OAuth machine-to-machine). Activepieces exchanges the client ID and secret for short-lived access tokens automatically.

1. In your Databricks workspace, open **Settings → Identity and access → Service principals** and add (or pick) a service principal.
2. On the service principal's **Secrets** tab, click **Generate secret** and copy the **Client ID** and **Secret**.
3. Grant the service principal **Can use** on the SQL warehouse, and the Unity Catalog privileges it needs (for example `USE CATALOG`, `USE SCHEMA`, `SELECT`, `MODIFY`, `READ VOLUME`, `WRITE VOLUME`). For Genie, give it **Can run** on the Genie space.
4. Copy your workspace URL from the browser address bar, e.g. `https://dbc-a1b2c3d4-e5f6.cloud.databricks.com`.
auth.props.clientId.description: The service principal's client ID (also called application ID), e.g. 6b1d5c2e-0a4f-4c3b-9f1e-2d7a8b9c0d1e.
auth.props.clientSecret.description: The OAuth secret generated on the service principal's Secrets tab.
auth.props.workspaceUrl.description: Your Databricks workspace URL, e.g. https://dbc-a1b2c3d4-e5f6.cloud.databricks.com or https://adb-1234567890123456.7.azuredatabricks.net
description: Data and AI platform: query and load Unity Catalog tables, upload files to volumes and ask Genie questions.
